title: Draft opted-in control machine rotation body
$comment: Not enabled by existing core rotate. Additionally enforce strict JSON duplicate/integer token rules, canonical base64url, 4096-byte body, valid P-384 point and candidate possession proof in exact trusted context. newKeyId must start alphanumeric, contain 16–128 base64url characters and at least 128 CSPRNG bits and be atomically persisted before send; provider rejects global conflicts/reuse.
